raw: {"requirements":[{"evidence_ids":["E1","E3","E10","E15","E19"],"problem_vi":"Người dùng mong muốn có tính năng hiển thị số điện thoại của shipper để dễ dàng liên lạc.","title_vi":"Bổ sung tính năng hiển thị số điện thoại của shipper","user_story":"As a buyer, I want to see the shipper's phone number, so that I can contact them directly about my delivery.","acceptance_criteria":["Given a delivery order, when I check the order details, then I can see the shipper's phone number displayed in the app.","Given a delivery order, when the shipper is assigned, then the shipper's phone number is available for the buyer to contact.","Given a delivery order, when the delivery is delayed, then I can call the shipper to inquire about the status."]}]}

{"requirements":[{"evidence_ids":["E1","E3","E5","E10","E17"],"problem_vi":"Tài khoản thường xuyên bị khóa hoặc không đăng nhập được.","title_vi":"Sửa lỗi tài khoản bị khóa hoặc không đăng nhập được","user_story":"As a user, I want to access my account without it being locked, so that I can use the app normally.","acceptance_criteria":["Given a user account, when the user attempts to log in, then the login should succeed without locking the account.","Given a user account that has been locked, when the user requests support, then the account should be reviewed and unlocked if appropriate.","Given a user account, when the user tries to link a bank account, then the linking process should complete without errors."]}]}

{"requirements":[{"evidence_ids":["E3","E4","E6","E9","E11"],"problem_vi":"Quảng cáo xuất hiện quá nhiều gây phiền phức cho người dùng.","title_vi":"Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo","user_story":"As a user, I want fewer ads, so that I can use the app without interruptions.","acceptance_criteria":["Given the app is open, when I navigate through the app, then the number of ads displayed is reduced.","Given the app is open, when I perform actions within the app, then I experience fewer interruptions from ads.","Given the app is open, when I view product listings, then the ads do not overwhelm the content."]}]}

{"requirements":[{"evidence_ids":["E1","E2","E10","E12","E14","E20"],"problem_vi":"Người dùng thường bị chuyển hướng đến Shopee khi đang sử dụng ứng dụng khác.","title_vi":"Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo","user_story":"As a shopper, I want to avoid being redirected to Shopee while using other apps, so that I can continue my activities without interruption.","acceptance_criteria":["Given the user is using another app, when they interact with an ad, then they should not be redirected to the Shopee app.","Given the user is playing a game, when an ad appears, then the ad should not cause the Shopee app to open unexpectedly.","Given the user is scrolling through social media, when they encounter an ad, then they should be able to dismiss the ad without being redirected."]}]}

{"requirements":[{"evidence_ids":["E1","E4","E8","E15"],"problem_vi":"Người dùng mong muốn có tính năng cho phép xem hàng trước khi thanh toán.","title_vi":"Bổ sung tính năng xem hàng trước khi thanh toán","user_story":"As a buyer, I want to see the product before payment, so that I can ensure its quality.","acceptance_criteria":["Given a product in the cart, when I choose to view the product, then I can see the product details before making the payment.","Given a product listing, when I select the option to view the product, then I can see the actual product image and description.","Given a product, when I attempt to make a payment, then I must have the option to view the product first."]}]}
